_comment: #1837 — type checking for a RATCHET, not a cleanup.
74% of non-test source files already carry annotations and nothing verified one
of them. `coder.types.pyright-ratchet` freezes today's errors into
.atdd/baselines/types_toolkit.yaml and fails only on NEW ones. Do not raise
typeCheckingMode to strict here to 'improve' things: it would invalidate the
frozen baseline wholesale, and a baseline that no longer describes the tree is
worse than no gate at all. Tighten by shrinking the baseline instead.
Fixture trees are excluded because they are DATA — deliberately broken sources
that validators parse, not code that is meant to type-check.
